settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Your name, as the header and footer wordmark and the name hero. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Reveal on scroll
settings.info: The name and the statements bloom in word by word; tiles, cards and CV rows fade up as the page scrolls. Off under reduced motion.

settings.label: Role
settings.info: One short line, shown above the name hero.

settings.label: Available for work
settings.info: The status dot is the accent colour when on, muted when off.

settings.label: Availability line
settings.info: Beside the dot in the hero and the footer. Leave empty to hide the status line.

settings.label: CV download
settings.info: Upload your CV as a PDF and link it here, for example: Download CV. The CV button hides when this is empty.

settings.label: Newsletter form
settings.info: Optional. The social links come from the social menu.
